method: Each answer is scored against the same checklist of what the student actually needs for the task (the items of the good prompt's FORMAT/EXAMPLE plus accuracy, honesty and, for Task 2, practical next steps). Every criterion is 0 = missing, 1 = partial, 2 = fully done. Quality Score = points / max points x 10. The scoring was done by Claude (the same model family that wrote the answers) after reading both answers in full, so it is a judgement, not an automatic metric; the reason for every score is given so it can be checked.
